title: EU MIUI 14.0.1.0 ROM Review on Xiaomi 11T Pro Is It Worth Flashing?
blurb: EU MIUI 14.0.1.0 running on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a full look at the build, what it changes, and who it actually suits.
video_description:
EU MIUI 14.0.1.0 running on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a full look at the build, what it changes, and who it actually suits.

The EU builds are a community take on MIUI rather than a stock global package, so the expectations going in are a little different. What I care about is what the ROM does to the things I touch every hour: the notification shade, the launcher, the camera app, and how quickly the whole thing wakes up from a cold start. A version number on a page tells you nothing. Time on the device tells you everything.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi 11T Pro (vili)
🧩 ROM     : EU MIUI 14.0.1.0

📌 What I Went Through
• A clean boot and setup on the 11T Pro
• The MIUI features EU builds tend to unlock
• Everyday behaviour instead of a static features list
• What stays genuinely stock and what doesn't

🧭 Who This Rom Suits
• Someone who wants MIUI, not AOSP, and is tired of the stock preload
• Anyone who wants the EU feature set without learning a whole new interface
• People who are fine with a custom build and the small upkeep it brings

❓ Quick Answers
• Do I need an unlocked bootloader? Yes. There's no way around it.
• Will it wipe my data? Yes — treat it as a fresh start and back up first.
• Does it need root? No. Root is optional here.
• Can I go back to stock MIUI? Yes, a fastboot package is the route back.
